name: medora/medora-authority
description: AI Authority Platform for WordPress — makes a site a trusted, machine-readable knowledge source for AI search engines and LLMs.

scripts-descriptions.test: Unit suite. Fast, needs no WordPress install.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:check: Fail if the template is stale or a string cannot be extracted.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:build: Compile languages/*.po into the .mo and .json WordPress loads.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:merge: Merge a translation map into a locale's .po, keeping reviewer edits.
scripts-descriptions.audit: Static audit for declared-but-unconsumed code, unsanitised input and uninstall leaks.
scripts-descriptions.package: Build the installable ZIP into dist/. Run `npm run build` and `i18n:build` first.
scripts-descriptions.package:check: Report whether the tree is ready to package, without writing anything.
